prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location of the accident as best you can.

A: It was at a large intersection with a traffic light. I was turning left from the main road onto a side street.

Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?

A: I was heading east in the left turn lane, waiting for the green arrow.

Q: Can you describe what happened when the light changed?

A: The arrow turned green, so I started into the turn. A car coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my vehicle. I think they had a yellow light and tried to go through.

Q: Were you able to stop before impact or did you have time to react?

A: I had started moving, so there wasn't time to stop. I braced the wheel and the impact threw me toward the right side of the car.

Q: Did you feel any injuries immediately after the collision?

A: My right shoulder hurt right away. It was sore, and by the next morning I could barely lift my arm above my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for the shoulder?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening and was referred to an orthopedic doctor. I have an appointment scheduled for an MRI.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the accident or your injuries?

A: Only that I have been taking time off work because of the pain, and I want to make sure my vehicle damage and medical bills are covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
